book.name: MATTHEW
book.title: Id ash d Matthew Oꞌohana ab Amjed g Jiosh Alidag

content: Mamtsh mua hegai John matsh am shonwuich g pahl wakona
D eda am hahasko haꞌi d ha‑kokownalig g Tutuligo ch d giꞌik. D idam am hema d kownal Galilee chekshani ch ed ch hab chehgig Herod. Kumd eda wehsko aꞌaga g Jesus.
Kush id hab ha ahgid g e‑hahaꞌichuga, “Heg oki d hegai mo wa ha pahl wapkonahim ch hab chehgig John. Mua ant. Kutki wabshaba uhpam e chegito k hekaj hab e nakog mat hab wo juh g s‑hasig haꞌichu.”

Herod atsh wa an bei g John k wulshp k ged hu si kuh am wehhejed g e‑hohnig. Id ash hab chehgig Herodias ch ash d chum hohnigaj g Herod wehnag. Kush heg hab chehgig Philip. Tsh g Herod ehs g hohnigaj.
Sh amjed g John chum hekid hab a aꞌaga, “Mo pi shaꞌi hiwgidas maps g e‑wehnag hohnig wo ehs.” Kush g Herodias heg hekaj ahgid g Herod mat ged hu wo si kuh.
Tsh g Herod chum s‑muꞌam nash pi am ahg g pi ap ha‑chuꞌijig. K wabshaba g Tutuligo hab kaij mo d Jiosh haꞌichu i tashogiddam. Kush s‑ha ehbid ch hekaj pi mua.
Kutsh am i e ai g Herod mahsidag. Sh geꞌe piastchud. Tsh g Herodias uwi mad am e waila ha tahgio. Tsh g Herod si s‑hohhoꞌi ihda
k wehs ha kaichudch si s‑kaidam hab kaij mat hemho wa wo mah mat haschu ab wo i tai.
Sh g jeꞌej hab ahg mat hab wo chei mat ab wo mah g moꞌoj g John am hoas‑haꞌa ch ed dahshk. Tsh wa woho heg ab tai.
Kutsh si pi ap e taht g kownal. Sh wabshaba wehsijj kah mo has i kaij. Tsh heg hekaj pi e nako mas pi am hu hab wo juh
k am hahawa hema cheha g shondal mat an wo him k wo shonch g John moꞌo.
Tsh wa woho hab e juh k am hahawa uꞌapa g moꞌoj am hoas‑haꞌa ch ed dahshch k ab mah ihda uwi. Kut ihda gd hu hahawa epai mah g e‑jeꞌe.
Kutsh am hahawa dada hegam mad ab si wecho e mashcham g John k am bei g honshpadaj k ged hu chehg k am hahawa hihim k ged hu ahgid g Jesus.
Matsh g Jesus am ha gegos g hetasp mihl chechoj ch muꞌi ehp
D am i kah g Jesus mamt mua g John k am hahawa gam hu hejelko s‑himimk. Kuchd an dadhaiwua wahlko ch ed k gam hu aigo i chehchsh haꞌabjed. Dki wabshaba kah g hemajkam k gn hu i bihbij wabsh hihimk.
Kuchd am dada k am wabsh i chum huhud. D eda muꞌijj am heki hu haꞌichug g hemajkam. D g Jesus si i s‑ha hoꞌigeꞌid k ha dodaj g kokꞌodam.

D gam hu si i juh. Kuchd am wui dada g Jesus k hab chum ahg, “Neh, mehk at waꞌi juh. K eda ia hu wabsh si jegko. Am g ha ahgid g hemajkam mat gam hu wo hihi kihhim wui k wo ha nolawt g haꞌichu hugi mat wo huh.”
D hab kaij g Jesus ab t‑wui, “Ahpim amt wo haꞌichu ha mah mat wo huh.”
Kuchd hab kaij ab wui, “Pi ach geꞌe haꞌichu edgid. Al hetasp sismito ch gohk waptopi ach am toꞌakch.”
D hab hahawa ep kaij g Jesus, “Ab g wo i uꞌukaꞌi.” Kud am e uꞌapa.

D am hahawa ha cheha g hemajkam mat am wo dadhaiwua washai ch ed. Kud am dadhaiwua. Kud am ui ihda hetasp sismito ch gohk waptopi k am e dahm i nen k ab hoꞌigeꞌel g Jiosh k am hahawa hahain k ab t‑mah. Kuchd gam hu aꞌai ha mahkhi g hemajkam.
Kuchd wehsijj hug k kokwod. Kuchd ahchim chuhchaij an hahawa i uꞌihim k uꞌapa g wihpiꞌidaj mat am huꞌi gamai gohk hoha wo ha shuhshud.
Kuchd am hu d i hetasp mihl chechoj ch muꞌijj g uꞌuwi ch aꞌal ehp.
Matsh ab wabsh hih g Jesus shuhdagi dahm
D am hahawa t‑ahgi g Jesus matt gam hu aigo wo hihi. Tsh heg am wo wiꞌi k am wo ha ahgi g hemajkam mat gam hu wo hihi e‑kihki wui. Kuchd an i chehchsh wahlko ch ed k gam hu hihi.
D g Jesus am ha dagito g hemajkam. Kud gam hu himto. D am hahawa hejel i chesh kawulk dahm k am e hoꞌigeꞌidahu. D am i hud. D am wabsh kia hejel haꞌichug.
D g t‑wahlko gam hu si eda i cheka g shuhdagi. Kud g hewel ab si s‑gewkam meh ab t‑wui. D g shuhdagi toꞌotonk am si aꞌai hab t‑wua wehs s‑chuhugam oidk.
Kud koi mahsi. D ab hema him t‑wui an wabsh shuhdagi dahm.
Kuchd ab i neidok si s‑ehbeni ch si hihnk ch hab kaij mo d wabsh kokꞌoi.
D ab hahawa si t‑wui neok ch d Jesus ch hab kaij, “Pi g wo shaꞌi ni‑ehbenid. Dani ahni. Mt oi wo s‑ap e taht.”
Kud g Peter si s‑kaidam hab kaij ab wui, “Ni‑kownalig, maptp d wo ahpik ch ab wo i ni‑wai. Nt ab wo i hih m‑wui an wabsh shuhdagi dahm.”
D hab kaij g Jesus, “Oi g ab i hihm.” D wa woho ab i hud wahlko t‑amjed k am wui i hih shuhdagi dahm.
D wabshaba am wabsh si s‑gewkam hewed. D g Peter si s‑ehbenid k gam hu wabsh i wachumkahi shuhdagi ch ed k ab si e shoꞌigchud k hab kaij, “Ni‑kownalig, ni‑doꞌibiani.”
D ha hekaj am i wuhshad g Jesus k hab kaij ab wui, “Pi apki ab hu si ni‑hiwig.”
D ged hu hahawa e wehm i chehchsh wahlko ch ed. D am waꞌi hekaj huhug g hewel.
Kuchd ab hahawa si has elid ch ab ihm g Jesus ch hab kaij ab wui, “Woho apki d Jiosh alidag.”
Matsh g Jesus ha dodaj g kokꞌodam Gennesaret t am
Ga achd hu aigo i chehchsh k ab dada Gennesaret t am.
Kud g hemajkam s‑amich g Jesus k hekaj ab i ha wai g kokꞌodam wehsko an heg oidk chekshani. Md ha uꞌapa Jesus wui
k ab si e shoꞌigchud k ab ahgid mat chum hems wabsh g kahbaj hugidag an wo taht. Kud s‑ap ha doda mad hedai an i taht.
